kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early ... (16:9-20, printed as part of Mark without comment)
note: The "longer ending" is absent from Sinaiticus and Vaticanus and unknown to Clement and Origen; Eusebius and Jerome say it was missing from most copies they knew, and its vocabulary and style differ from Mark's. SBLGNT prints it in double brackets as a later addition; KJV presents it as Mark's own text, including the snake-handling and poison promises of 16:17-18.

mine: [[But they reported briefly to Peter ... eternal salvation. Amen.]]
note: The "shorter ending", found in Codex Bobiensis (k) and several Greek manuscripts (L, Psi, 099) that also have the longer ending, is printed by SBLGNT in double brackets after 16:8; TR and KJV omit it.

kjv: he that believeth not shall be damned
mine: whoever does not believe will be condemned
note: katakrithesetai is "will be condemned" (judicial verdict); "damned" has acquired a specific sense of eternal perdition and an expletive use.
